title: MechanismSelectionView
description: Source of truth: derived projection of GovernanceState × Content.contentType × Proposal? × Manifest{kind: 'pillar-projection', pillar: 'qahal'} payload. Category C operational projection — reconstructable at any time from the substrate entries. Triggers: Signal::GovernanceStateUpdated, Signal::ContentCreated/Updated, Signal::ProposalCreated/Closed, Signal::ManifestUpdated{kind: 'pillar-projection', pillar: 'qahal'}.

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity

level.description: Mechanism ladder level (0–7). 0 = context menu only; 1 = reactions; 2 = graduated feedback; 3–7 = formal voting mechanisms

mechanism.description: Name of the selected mechanism: 'none' (level 0), 'reactions' (level 1), 'graduated-feedback' (level 2), or the proposal's votingMechanism (levels 3–7)

renderTarget.description: Which renderer handles this level. 'angular' for levels 0–2; 'psephos' for levels 3–7 (formal voting)

contextMenuOnly.description: True at level 0: only the context menu is available (no reactions, no feedback, no voting)

allowReactions.description: True at levels 1+: reaction bar is available

allowGraduatedFeedback.description: True at levels 2+: graduated feedback (Loomio-style scale) is available

activeProposalId.description: For levels 3–7: the ID of the active proposal driving the formal mechanism. Null when no active proposal.

activeProposalMechanism.description: For levels 3–7: the votingMechanism of the active proposal (e.g. 'approval', 'ranked-choice'). Null when no active proposal.

policyManifestCid.description: CID of the pillar-projection Manifest whose mechanism_ladder was applied. Null when protocol defaults applied.

computedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this projection was last computed
